en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a hilly rural village with tightly clustered houses. Many buildings are traditional half‑timbered structures with steep gabled tile roofs and plaster infill, surrounded by trees and small gardens. Narrow roads wind between the houses, and wooden and masonry facades dominate the foreground. There are telephone or power poles but no visible cars or modern signage.
